7253.description_text: Fruiting Bodies, Nothing Else Lion's Mane has a reputation for cutting corners — mycelium-heavy formulas, grain-based fillers, low-potency powders. This isn't that. KIKI Health uses only the fruiting body of the mushroom, cultivated on a wood-rich substrate and processed through hot-water extraction to concentrate the compounds held within its cell structure. The result is a clean, grain-free, starch-free extract standardised to 50% beta-glucan-rich polysaccharides. What Extraction Actually Means Raw mushroom powder and extracted mushroom powder are not the same thing. Hot-water extraction breaks down the tough cellular walls that the mushroom's active compounds sit behind, helping concentrate compounds from the mushroom in each capsule. Each vegicap delivers 400mg of extract — nothing added, no bulking agents, no mycelium. Who This Is For Anyone looking for a straightforward, high-potency Lion's Mane supplement without the guesswork. Fully organic, certified vegan, and easy to fit around mealtimes. Available in a 60-capsule pack with a flexible daily serving of two to four capsules. Ingredients 100% Organic Lion's Mane (Hericium erinaceus) Mushroom Extract from fruiting bodies (400mg). Methylcobalamin — an active form of vitamin B12 — sits at the core, alongside B6, folate, thiamin, riboflavin and niacin, all of which contribute to normal energy-yielding metabolism. Magnesium contributes to the reduction of tiredness and fatigue. A proprietary botanical blend includes milk thistle, ginger root, ashwagandha, NAC, prickly pear and grape seed extract. Eight Hours of Overnight Wear Applied to clean, hair-free skin before drinking, the patch is worn for around eight hours. The hypoallergenic fabric is gentle enough for overnight use. One patch per occasion — straightforward to use, easy to remember. 7399.description_text: Twenty-Five Nutrients. One Patch. For anyone juggling a busy life and a medicine cabinet full of bottles, the Kind Patches Boost Patch offers a different approach. One patch, worn for eight hours, is designed to deliver a broad spectrum of 25 vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants via the skin — no water, no swallowing, no scheduling multiple supplements around meals. What's Inside The formula covers genuine nutritional ground. Vitamin D3 at 1000% NRV, vitamin K2 as menaquinone-7, iron as bisglycinate, chromium picolinate, and a full B-vitamin complex sit alongside zinc, magnesium, selenium, iodine, and more. Vitamin C contributes to the protection of cells from oxidative stress. B vitamins including thiamine, riboflavin, niacin, and pantothenic acid contribute to normal energy-yielding metabolism. Wear It and Forget It Apply to clean, dry, hair-free skin and leave it to work while you get on with your day. No mid-afternoon reminders. No pill fatigue. Just a simple, consistent habit that fits wherever you stick it. 7482.description_text: What Are Myvitamins CO-Q10 Tablets? Myvitamins Co-Q10 is a source of the essential natural nutrient, co-enzyme Q10 or ubiquinol, that is found naturally in the body. As a co-enzyme, it supports other enzymes in the body to carry out essential functions including energy production and absorption of other nutrients. Why Use Myvitamins CO-Q10 Tablets? Its name may not sound natural, but Co-Q10 is a vitamin-like molecule that is found in cells all over our bodies. We produce it naturally, but only in small amount that decline as we age. Supplements can help to support these levels. Expertly formulated into a convenient tablet, our Co-Q10 is designed to support our natural levels, especially as we age. What Works Well With Co-Q10? Our natural levels of collagen also decline as we age. Try taking our Coconut & Collagen Capsules with our CO-Q10 tablets to support your levels of both nutrients.
